description: School principals plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of teachers and other staff of an elementary or secondary school. They are employed by public and private schools. Administrators of elementary and secondary education plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the academic affairs of a school system. They are employed by school boards.
duties: This group performs some or all of the following duties:
Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through department heads or supervisors, the activities of teachers and support staff
Review programs to ensure conformance to school board or provincial standards and develop programs within limits of authority
Coordinate teaching activities of the institution by making personnel assignments, determining class size and preparing timetables
Organize and maintain procedures for the keeping of records
Prepare and administer institution or program budget
Direct and coordinate school maintenance services and the use of school facilities
May recruit and hire teachers and other staff
Administrators of elementary and secondary education
Plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through school principals, the academic affairs of a school district
Evaluate curriculum, teaching methods and community participation in programs for a school district and revise programs as required
Develop and administer programs for the education and training of students and adults
Make recommendations concerning the annual operating budget of a school district
Direct the recruitment, appointment, training, evaluation and promotion of teaching personnel.
requirements: A bachelor's degree in education is required.
A master's degree in education may be required.
Several years of experience as a senior teacher or department head are required.
A teacher's certificate for the province of employment is required.
School principals may require a principal's certificate.
Administrators of elementary and secondary education may require a supervisory officer certificate.

drivers.name: Scheduling Work and Activities
drivers.reason: Constraint-based schedules and routine coordination can be substantially assisted by software.

drivers.name: Communicating with Coworkers
drivers.reason: Summaries, drafts and translations can support workplace communication; shared context and relationships remain.

drivers.name: Analyzing Data or Information
drivers.reason: Models and analytical tools can assist interpretation and analysis; data quality and specialist judgment remain necessary.

constraints.name: Establishing and Maintaining Interpersonal Relationships
constraints.reason: Suggested messages can help, but software does not replace reciprocal human trust and relationships.

constraints.name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others
constraints.reason: Preparation and scenario analysis can be assisted; trust, authority and resolution involve people.

constraints.name: Supervising Subordinates
constraints.reason: Administrative supervision can be supported; responsibility, feedback and staff relationships remain human work.

humanContext.name: Consequences of error
humanContext.reason: Higher consequences strengthen the case for human verification.

humanContext.name: Health and safety responsibility
humanContext.reason: Responsibility for people’s safety makes human oversight important.

humanContext.name: Responsibility for outcomes
humanContext.reason: Accountability for outcomes remains with people and organizations.

humanContext.name: Face-to-face discussion
humanContext.reason: Frequent in-person discussion provides context that software alone does not supply.

activities.name: Estimating Quantifiable Characteristics
activities.reason: Software can assist estimates and calculations; obtaining reliable real-world inputs still matters.

activities.name: Getting Information
activities.reason: Search, retrieval and summarization can assist gathering digital information; access and verification remain constraints.

activities.name: Identifying Objects, Actions and Events
activities.reason: Models can help classify supplied information or images, but direct observation and context are often needed.

activities.name: Inspecting Equipment, Structures or Material
activities.reason: Image or document review can assist inspection; physical access, measurement and accountability remain human work.

activities.name: Monitoring Processes, Materials or Systems
activities.reason: Software can summarize readings and flag anomalies; monitoring physical processes requires sensors and intervention.

activities.name: Controlling Machines and Processes
activities.reason: Generating instructions does not itself control or safely operate physical equipment. Robotics is outside this index.

activities.name: Developing Technical Instructions
activities.reason: Drafting, explaining and revising technical instructions are digital language tasks, with expert verification required.

activities.name: Documenting and Recording Information
activities.reason: Transcription, structured extraction and document drafting are directly addressable by generative software.

activities.name: Electronic Maintenance
activities.reason: Diagnostic advice can assist, while handling, repairing and testing equipment remain physical activities.

activities.name: Handling and Manipulating Objects
activities.reason: Software alone cannot handle physical objects. This index excludes robotics.

activities.name: Managing Resources
activities.reason: Planning and analysis can be assisted; allocating resources and accepting responsibility require organizational authority.

activities.name: Mechanical Maintenance
activities.reason: Instructions can assist troubleshooting, but software does not perform hands-on mechanical repairs.

activities.name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices or Equipment
activities.reason: Vehicle and equipment operation are outside this software-only generative AI scope.

activities.name: Performing Physical Activities
activities.reason: Bodily effort and movement cannot be performed by software alone.

activities.name: Processing Information
activities.reason: Compiling, classifying, coding and checking digital information offer substantial software assistance potential.

activities.name: Analyzing Data or Information
activities.reason: Models and analytical tools can assist interpretation and analysis; data quality and specialist judgment remain necessary.

activities.name: Setting Objectives and Formulating Strategies
activities.reason: Models can develop options and scenarios; organizational priorities and final decisions remain accountable human choices.

activities.name: Evaluating
activities.reason: Comparing evidence can be assisted; context, judgment and verification limit unattended use.

activities.name: Judging Quality
activities.reason: Digital evidence may be reviewed by models, but physical quality, standards and acceptance often require people.

activities.name: Making Decisions
activities.reason: Decision support is feasible; authority, consequences of error and context limit autonomous decisions.

activities.name: Planning and Organizing
activities.reason: Software can draft plans, schedules and workflows; implementation and coordination remain necessary.

activities.name: Scheduling Work and Activities
activities.reason: Constraint-based schedules and routine coordination can be substantially assisted by software.

activities.name: Thinking Creatively
activities.reason: Generative tools can produce drafts, code, designs and ideas; direction, originality and quality control vary by setting.

activities.name: Updating and Applying Knowledge

activities.name: Assisting and Caring for Others

activities.name: Coaching and Developing Others

activities.name: Establishing and Maintaining Interpersonal Relationships
activities.reason: Suggested messages can help, but software does not replace reciprocal human trust and relationships.

activities.name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others
activities.reason: Explanation, translation and summarization are directly supported by generative models, with verification.

activities.name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public
